description: Principal can RDP to the target computer (interactive logon).

telemetry.detail: Successful logon type 10 (RemoteInteractive) - default-on and easy to baseline per user/host.
Interactive RDP is high-visibility: leaves a full credential cache on the target and is often watched for lateral anomalies.

prerequisite_privilege: Remote Desktop Users membership (or admin) on target
abuse_primitive: RDP session to the target host.
notes: Logon type 10 is distinctive and default-logged. Prefer WinRM/WMI where the objective allows.
